# ScheduledClicker

Free local Windows 11 and macOS 13+ scheduling tool. Stable v1.1.2 supports one scheduled single/double click. Candidate 1.2.0-preview.2 adds bounded recurring prompt input/send, five languages and light/dark switching; it is not a stable release.

- [Website](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/)
- [Stable downloads](https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker/releases/latest)
- [Preview behavior and setup](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/recurring-input/)
- [Preview downloads](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/download/#preview)
- [Windows](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/windows-scheduled-auto-clicker/)
- [macOS permissions and platform](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/macos-scheduled-auto-clicker/)
- [FAQ](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/faq/)
- [Safety and clipboard behavior](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/safety-and-verification/)
- [Full versioned product facts](https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/llms-full.txt)
- [Source and license](https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker)
- [Candidate verification](https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker/blob/codex/recurring-prompt-loop/VERIFICATION.md)

The loop overwrites the clipboard and performs real input. Keep the computer awake/unlocked and target fixed. It does not detect AI completion, quota availability or delivery, and does not bypass limits. Mac CI does not establish native-input acceptance on a user desktop. See the versioned verification report.

Updated 2026-10-15. Supplemental summary; not a guarantee of indexing, ranking or AI citation.
